Exterior Sound:
When using the exterior sound interaction feature ("this feature"), please pay special attention to and follow these notes 
(Note: you can find them at any time in the User Manual) 
 
1. Use this feature only when the vehicle is completely stopped and in Park (P). While driving, concentrate on driving and do not turn this feature on. 
2. With this feature on, people outside may hear sound from inside the car. Make sure the other occupants agree before turning it on, and take care not to disclose private information. 
3. Know and follow the applicable laws and local rules. Do not use this feature near schools, residential areas, office buildings, no-horn zones or other places unsuitable for loud sound. Keep the volume reasonable for the surroundings to avoid noise pollution or disturbing others. 
4. When playing your own audio or using the megaphone outside, make sure the content complies with laws, regulations and public order, and does not infringe anyone's rights. 
5. This feature must not be used for any commercial purpose. 
 
When you lend the vehicle to someone, inform them and make sure they understand and follow these notes before using this feature. 
 
You are responsible for any complaints, penalties, compensation or other liability caused by you or other users not following these notes. Make sure you and all other users fully follow them before turning this feature on.
